## Description
Describe the changes introduced in this pull request and the rationale behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] UI / Styling enhancement

## Verification & Testing
- [ ] TypeScript compilation passes (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Codebase lint passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Tested in Windows Desktop environment (if modifying electron / IPC)
- [ ] Verified SPT directory routing (SPT 3.x and 4.x layout)
- [ ] Zero regression on mod installations, uninstallation, or launcher chain

## Screenshots / Evidence (if applicable)
Attach UI screenshots or test output demonstrating the change.
